review: Dieci Hong Lu is a Sinking Damage Dealing ID that works in an incredibly different way compared to all of the other IDs in the game. His Skill 1 scales off of the amount of insight he has and his game plan is to keep and maintain high insight at all times whenever possible. This can be done with a technique called "Insight Locking" where you use his defense skill on his slots so you won't discard anything, making his insight stay at 3 at all times to maximize his damage Other than that, whenever he comes online, this Identity has some pretty good clashes, S2 and S3 roll up to 22 and 23.
